concerns.text: Task T001 lists target provenance files but does not specify how completion will be verified (e.g., existence check, content validation). Add an explicit verification step such as “verify that each file exists and contains the required amendment text”.

Task T002 lacks a verification clause; the reviewer cannot know when the amendment document is considered done. Include a check like “assert file amendment_draft.md exists and matches the expected FR/SC replacements”.
Task T004 (apply amendments to spec.md) does not state how success is confirmed. Add a verification step (e.g., diff against amendment_draft.md or a checksum comparison).
Task T005 (apply amendments to plan.md) is missing explicit verification (e.g., file existence and updated Constitution‑check table).
Task T006 (configure linting & formatting) does not define a verification method. Specify that the presence of pyproject.toml with the expected Ruff/Black settings constitutes success.
Task T007 (create data directories) lacks a verification clause. Add a check that the listed directories exist after execution.
Task T008 (create test directories) does not include verification. Require existence of the three test directories.
Task T009 (configure Pytest) does not state how to confirm configuration. Include a verification step such as “pytest --collect-only succeeds and reads pytest.ini”.
Task T010 (write quickstart.md) lacks verification. Add a check that the file exists and contains at least one code‑block example.
Task T011 (create contracts placeholder) does not specify verification. Require existence of specs/contracts/README.md.
Task T012 (create data‑model.md) missing verification. Add existence and schema‑validation step.
Task T013 (implement data‑pipeline modules) lists multiple files but provides no verification. Define that each listed module must exist and import without error.
Task T014 (create data orchestrator) does not include verification. Require that src/data/main.py runs without exception and produces valid_events.json.
Task T015 (write tests for the data pipeline) lacks a verification clause. Specify that pytest passes all unit and integration tests.
Task T016 (lossless compression module) does not define verification. Add that lossless wrappers import correctly and produce files that match original byte‑wise.
Task T017 (lossy compression module) missing verification. Require that each lossy method runs and returns a compressed file.
Task T018 (JPEG2000 validation helper) lacks verification. Include a test that validate_transformation_artifact returns a float and matches expected MSE for a known sample.
Task T019 (metrics module) does not state verification. Add unit tests for mse and snr_degradation functions.
Task T020 (compression driver) is a large orchestration step with no verification. Define that running src/compression/main.py produces compression_results.json with the required fields and flags.

Task T020 is too coarse; it bundles reading, compressing, metric calculation, and flagging into a single task. Consider splitting into separate tasks for (a) reading inputs, (b) applying each compression method, (c) computing metrics, and (d) flagging unacceptable SNR degradation.
Task T021 (tests for compression) does not specify verification beyond test existence. Require that pytest passes both unit and integration tests and that the integration test checks the JSON fields.
Task T022 (Bilby wrapper) missing verification. Add that run_bilby.py executes without error and writes a .h5 file.
Task T023 (failure‑detection module) lacks verification. Require that check_hierarchical_convergence returns a boolean for a sample ESS value.
Task T024 (comparison & statistical‑test module) does not define verification. Include a test that the module produces statistical_test_results.json with expected keys.

Task T025 (PE orchestrator) is overly broad, combining looping, PE runs, and report generation. Split into (a) loop driver, (b) per‑event PE invocation, (c) results aggregation, and (d) report writing.

Task T026 (tests for the PE pipeline) lacks explicit verification. Require that pytest passes all unit and integration tests and that the integration test validates statistical_test_results.json contains entries for all three parameters.
Task T027 (execute end‑to‑end pipeline) does not specify verification. Define that src/main.py runs without error and produces the three listed artifacts, each validated for schema correctness.
Task T027 is too coarse; it bundles full pipeline execution and artifact generation. Consider separating execution from artifact validation.
Task T028 (paper‑stage handoff) lacks verification. Require that research.md is updated and contains the specified narrative and reproducibility checklist.
Task T029 (update top‑level README) does not define verification. Add that README exists and includes the listed sections.
Task T030 (add API documentation) missing verification. Require that docs/api.md exists and contains function signatures for all public modules.
Task T031 (performance sanity check) lacks verification. Define that a CI job records total runtime and fails if >6 h, emitting a warning.
